Thackeray's stories of "Stubbs' Calendar, or the Fatal Boots," which subsequently appeared as "Stubbs' Diary;" and "Barber Cox, or the Cutting of his Comb," formed the leading attractions in the numbers for 1839 and 1840.

arxiv-2111-00736.title: Improved superconducting qubit state readout by path interference
arxiv-2111-00736.creator: Zhiling Wang, Zenghui Bao, Yukai Wu, Yan Li, Cheng Ma, Tianqi Cai, Yipu Song, Hongyi Zhang, Luming Duan
arxiv-2111-00736.description: Abstract High fidelity single shot qubit state readout is essential for many quantum information processing protocols. In superconducting quantum circuit, the qubit state is usually determined by detecting the dispersive frequency shift of a microwave cavity from either transmission or reflection.

arxiv-2212-09577.title: CiteBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Citation Text Generation
arxiv-2212-09577.creator: Martin Funkquist, Ilia Kuznetsov, Yufang Hou, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2212-09577.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Martin Funkquist, Ilia Kuznetsov, Yufang Hou, Iryna Gurevych. Science progresses by building upon the prior body of knowledge documented in scientific publications. The acceleration of research makes it hard to stay up-to-date with the recent developments and to summarize the ever-growing body of prior work. To address this, the task of citation text generation aims to produce accurate textual summaries given a set of papers-to-cite and the citing paper context.

arxiv-2304-13923.title: Retrieval-based Knowledge Augmented Vision Language Pre-training Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29–November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada. Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’23), October 29–November 3, 2023,
arxiv-2304-13923.creator: Jiahua Rao, Zifei Shan, Longpo Liu, Yao Zhou, Yuedong Yang
arxiv-2304-13923.description: Abstract . With the recent progress in large-scale vision and language representation learning, Vision Language Pre-training (VLP) models have achieved promising improvements on various multi-modal downstream tasks. Albeit powerful, these models have not fully leveraged world knowledge to their advantage. A key challenge of knowledge-augmented VLP is the lack of clear connections between knowledge and multi-modal data.

arxiv-2401-07915.title: Survey of Learning-based Approaches for Robotic In-Hand Manipulation
arxiv-2401-07915.creator: Abraham Itzhak Weinberg, Alon Shirizly, Osher Azulay, Avishai Sintov
arxiv-2401-07915.description: Abstract Human dexterity is an invaluable capability for precise manipulation of objects in complex tasks. The capability of robots to similarly grasp and perform in-hand manipulation of objects is critical for their use in the ever changing human environment, and for their ability to replace manpower.

arxiv-2502-14346.title: Représentations des quaternions de norme 1 1

arxiv-2502-14346.description: Abstract . Let p p be a prime number, F F a local field with finite residue field of characteristic p p , D D the quaternion division algebra with centre F F , and R R an algebraically closed field of any characteristic char R \operatorname{char}_{R} .

arxiv-2505-23471.title: Synthesizing Performance Constraints for Evaluating and Improving Code Efficiency
arxiv-2505-23471.creator: Jun Yang, Cheng-Chi Wang, Bogdan Alexandru Stoica, Kexin Pei
arxiv-2505-23471.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have been increasingly used to optimize code efficiency. Evaluating their effectiveness and further suggesting optimization opportunities often rely on high-quality tests to demonstrate the performance bottlenecks presented in the program. However, existing approaches rely on a limited set of hand-curated inputs or LLM-generated uninteresting length-stressing tests, failing to reveal more nuanced optimization opportunities.

arxiv-2511-11583.title: Parallel and Multi-Stage Knowledge Graph Retrieval for Behaviorally Aligned Financial Asset Recommendations
arxiv-2511-11583.creator: Fernando Spadea, Oshani Seneviratne
arxiv-2511-11583.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) show promise for personalized financial recommendations but are hampered by context limits, hallucinations, and a lack of behavioral grounding. Our prior work, FLARKO, embedded structured knowledge graphs (KGs) in LLM prompts to align advice with user behavior and market data.

openalex-w7214095951.title: MUDANÇAS NO USO DA TERRA E INTENSIFICAÇÃO CLIMÁTICA NO BRASIL: EVIDÊNCIAS DE UMA REVISÃO INTEGRATIVA
openalex-w7214095951.creator: José Junho Rodrigues, Virgínia de Fátima Bezerra Nogueira, Kylvia Luciana Pereira Costa, José Renan Alexandre da Nóbrega, Edgley Gonçalves Alves Segundo, Alex Sandro Dantas de Medeiros, Ralina Fernandes Santos de França Medeiros, Sara Vitoriano de Sousa Roberto, Mirla Guimarães Linhares de Oliveira, Ana Maria Ribeiro de Aragão, Michael Douglas Sousa Leite
openalex-w7214095951.source: OpenAlex / Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação
openalex-w7214095951.description: As transformações no uso e ocupação do solo constituem um dos principais vetores de intensificação das mudanças climáticas no Brasil, impulsionadas pelo avanço do desmatamento, da expansão agropecuária mecanizada, da urbanização desordenada e da pressão sobre ecossistemas...

pmc-10626838.title: Tiza–Titre increase and enhanced immunity through an adjuvanted, recombinant herpes zoster subunit vaccine in patients with liver cirrhosis and post-liver transplantation: a study protocol for a prospective cohort study
pmc-10626838.creator: Stephanie Vollmer-Raschdorf, Jassin Rashidi-Alavijeh, Sebastian Voigt, Hartmut Hengel, Benjamin Borchardt, Daniela Huzly, Eva-Maria Hüßler, Jürgen in der Schmitten, Anne Halenius, Katharina Willuweit, Suzan Botzenhardt, Mirko Trilling, Tobias Boettler, Dorothea Dehnen
pmc-10626838.description: IntroductionShingrix, an effective adjuvanted, recombinant herpes zoster vaccine (RZV), has been available since 2018. Immunocompromised patients are known to be predisposed to vaccine failure. In-vitro testing of immunological surrogates of vaccine protection could be instrumental for monitoring vaccination success. So far, no test procedure is available for vaccine responses to RZV that could be used on a routine basis.

pmc-10740918.title: Antibiotic Resistance: Do We Need Only Cutting-Edge Methods, or Can New Visions Such as One Health Be More Useful for Learning from Nature?
pmc-10740918.creator: Maria Vitale, Lene Karine Vestby
pmc-10740918.description: Antibiotic resistance is an increasing global problem for public health, and focusing on biofilms has provided further insights into resistance evolution in bacteria. Resistance is innate in many bacterial species, and many antibiotics are derived from natural molecules of soil microorganisms. Is it possible that nature can help control AMR diffusion?

pmc-11468206.title: Secular variation and risk factors of preterm birth in Hainan, the Free Trade Port in China from 2010 to 2021
pmc-11468206.creator: Qing Luo, Weijia Wu, Chao Li, Anping Zhao, Dan Zhao, Chuican Huang, Lichun Fan
pmc-11468206.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). ObjectivesPreterm delivery rates have increased obviously worldwide over the past decade, yet reliable epidemiological studies on the incidence of preterm birth and temporal trends are not available in Hainan, The Free Trade Port in China.

pmc-12386899.title: The Multifaceted Role of Mitochondria in Angiogenesis
pmc-12386899.creator: Sara Cannito, Ida Giardino, Maria d’Apolito, Massimo Pettoello-Mantovani, Francesca Scaltrito, Domenica Mangieri, Annamaria Piscazzi
pmc-12386899.description: Angiogenesis, the formation of new blood vessels from pre-existing ones, is crucial for various physiological and pathological conditions, including embryonic development, wound healing, tissue regeneration and tumor progression. While traditionally attributed to the actions of growth factors and their receptors, emerging evidence highlights the crucial regulatory roles of mitochondria in angiogenesis.

pmc-12452356.title: A Single-Nucleus Transcriptomic Atlas of the Mouse Lumbar Spinal Cord: Functional Implications of Non-Coding RNAs
pmc-12452356.creator: Pablo Ruiz-Amezcua, Miguel Nieto Hernández, Javier García Flores, Clara Plaza Alonso, David Reigada, Teresa Muñoz-Galdeano, Eva Vargas, Rodrigo M Maza, Francisco J Esteban, Manuel Nieto-Díaz, Manuela Ferracin
pmc-12452356.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The adult lumbar spinal cord plays a critical role in locomotor control and somatosensory integration, whose transcriptional architecture under physiological conditions has been characterized in various studies with restricted numbers of individuals (up to four). Here, we present an integrative single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) atlas of the healthy adult mouse lumbar spinal cord, assembled from over 86,000 nuclei from 16 samples across five public datasets.

pmc-12569111.title: A dual-channel hyperspectral classification method based on NAS and transformer
pmc-12569111.creator: Wenbin Liu, Juanjuan Li, Yiliang Zeng, Na Meng, Jiahong Zhao
pmc-12569111.description: Transformer networks present excellent performance in capturing long distance dependencies between different locations in the input sequence and are highly capable on a global scale. Recently, several neural architecture search (NAS) algorithms have been proposed for hyperspectral image (HSI) classification, which further improves the accuracy of HSI classification to a new level with more attention paid to local information.

pmc-12697599.title: Innovations in Thrombectomy Training: A Systematic Review and Expert Recommendations from the Society of Vascular and Interventional Neurology‐Mission Thrombectomy Initiative
pmc-12697599.creator: Fawaz Al‐Mufti, Mohamed Elfil, Abdallah Abbas, Haneen Sabet, Hazem S Ghaith, Ariel Sacknovitz, Ankita Jain, Victor Urrutia, Nabeel Herial, Gabor Toth, Mohamad El‐Ghanem, Krishna Amuluru, Viktor C Szeder, Jonathan Crowe, Karol Budohoski, Zurab Nadareishvili, Kaustubh Limaye, Fazeel Siddiqui, Boris Pa
pmc-12697599.description: BACKGROUNDMechanical thrombectomy is a critical intervention for patients with acute ischemic stroke with large vessel occlusion. However, significant barriers remain in its widespread implementation, particularly in low‐ to middle‐income countries, including a shortage of trained physicians and limited access to advanced medical technologies.

pmc-12744369.title: A de novo variant of the COL3A1 gene: causality of vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome
pmc-12744369.creator: Estrella Gutiérrez Romero, Nuria Padilla Apuntate, Silvia Izquierdo Álvarez
pmc-12744369.description: ObjectivesTo establish diagnosis of vascular Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (VEDS) through genetic testing. This syndrome is characterized by muscle and arterial ruptures and a tendency to easy brusing, thin skin with visible veins and acrogeric facial features that may be caused by pathogenic variants (PVs) in heterozygosis in the COL3A1 gene.

pmc-13277390.title: Multimorbidity and the Number of Conditions Increase With the Duration of Type 1 Diabetes and Associate With Increased Mortality
pmc-13277390.creator: Anni Ylinen, Stefan Mutter, Stefanie Hägg‐Holmberg, Susanna Satuli‐Autere, Valma Harjutsalo, Per‐Henrik Groop, Lena M. Thorn, the FinnDiane Study Group
pmc-13277390.description: BackgroundMultimorbidity in type 1 diabetes has previously not been studied in detail. Therefore, we aimed to assess the prevalence of multimorbidity and its association with mortality in type 1 diabetes.MethodsThis observational follow‐up study includes 4069 individuals with type 1 diabetes from the Finnish Diabetic Nephropathy study.

pmc-13335852.title: Ultrafast Dynamics of Spin Current and Electron Temperature in Spintronic Terahertz Emitters
pmc-13335852.creator: Yifan Wang, Zuanming Jin, Miao Cai, Zhiqiang Lan, Zhenjie Ge, Zheng Feng, Wei Tan, Alexei V Balakin, Alexander P Shkurinov, Yan Peng, Yiming Zhu
pmc-13335852.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Femtosecond laser‐pumped spintronic terahertz (THz) emissions have attracted intense academic interest, thanks to their intrinsic capability to generate ultrafast THz pulses that cover a wide spectral range. To gain deep insight into the interplay between the ultrafast thermal dynamics in ferromagnets and the spin‐to‐charge conversion is critical for advancing this field, yet up to now it has not been fully explored, partially due to a lack of efficient tools to measure these two processes simultaneously.

pmc-13341679.title: The First Wave: National Adoption and Economic Shifts of Posterior Cervical Decompression and Fusion in Hospital-Owned Ambulatory Surgery Centers
pmc-13341679.creator: Mitchell K. Ng, Leonidas E. Mastrokostas, Paul G. Mastrokostas, Ilan Podolski, Mohamed Said, Rajendra Singh, Pemla Jagtiani, Alexander Kucherina, Masataka Mizuno, Jad Bou Monsef, Arya Varthi, Daniel R. Fassett, Andrew P. Alvarez, Thomas D. Cha, Jose A. Canseco, Alan S. Hilibrand, Alexander R. Vaccar
pmc-13341679.description: Study DesignRetrospective cross-sectional study.ObjectiveTo evaluate national trends in utilization and inflation-adjusted charges for single-level posterior cervical decompression and fusion (PCDF) performed in hospital-owned ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).MethodsThe National Ambulatory Surgery Sample was queried from 2016 to 2022 for adult ASC encounters with CPT 22600, corresponding to single-level posterior cervical fusion.

pmc-13396613.title: Discovery of novel peptidomimetics against HSP90–HOP interactions towards improved cancer therapeutics using machine learning strategies
pmc-13396613.creator: Sarath Perumal, Ramanathan Karuppasamy
pmc-13396613.description: BackgroundThe HSP90–HOP interaction orchestrates transfer of client proteins from HSP70 to HSP90, promoting their conformational maturation and stabilisation and thereby sustaining oncogenic signalling. The study explores a promising alternative for cancer chemotherapy by targeting this interface rather than the traditional ATP-binding site, which may circumvent the toxicity associated with classical HSP90 inhibitors.

pmc-13679370.title: Three-dimensional deep learning nomogram for post-plan quality assurance in high-dose-rate prostate brachytherapy☆
pmc-13679370.creator: Joel Beaudry, Tonghe Wang, Shirin A. Enger, Antonio L. Damato
pmc-13679370.description: PurposeClassical nomograms for high-dose-rate (HDR) prostate brachytherapy quality assurance (QA) evaluate agreement between planned and expected total dwell time but do not directly assess the three-dimensional treated volume. This study's aim was to develop a deep learning-based 3D nomogram to predict institution-specific clinical 100% isodose volumes from anatomy and dwell positions for post-plan QA.

pmc-13680327.title: Comparable efficacy of extraoral and intraoral photobiomodulation in preventing oral mucositis during high-dose methotrexate therapy in pediatric oncology: A single-blind randomized controlled trial
pmc-13680327.creator: Isabela de Oliveira Plugge Freitas, Isabela Schuartz, Giovanna Leal Klein Renz, Rafael Zancan Mobile, Mariana Lena Sassi França, Mara Albonei Dudeque Pianovski, Laurindo Moacir Sassi, Melissa Rodrigues de Araujo
pmc-13680327.description: PurposeThis prospective randomized controlled clinical study compared intraoral (IO) and extraoral (EO) photobiomodulation (PBM) for the prevention of chemotherapy-induced oral mucositis (OM) in pediatric oncology patients.MethodsA total of 155 patients (1–18 years), receiving high-dose methotrexate (HDMTX) for leukemia, lymphoma, or osteosarcoma, were randomized to PBM-IO (n = 73) or PBM-EO (n = 82).
